check-resource-scheduling.mjs.note: Executes the production usage, editor and explorer hooks with controlled visibility and cached IPC readings. Protects stable polling, foreground catch-up, idle timers and manager cleanup; does not measure native CPU or RAM.

check-cloud-staging-launcher.mjs.note: Compiles the project-scoped macOS launcher and executes disposable-home isolation checks without launching Gyro or accessing the user's app data.

check-cloud-staging-build.mjs.note: Executes staging build-pin validation across partial cutover, production collision, malformed origins and secret-key inputs without network or build side effects.

check-google-models.mjs.note: Executes provider migration and discovered-model merges with explicit fixture metadata; no live Google transport.

check-google-models-browser.mjs.note: Drives the production model picker in Chromium with discovered models and unknown context metadata.

check-live-model-context.mjs.note: Executes context allocation precedence, expiry, provider isolation, and stream updates against explicit fixture readings.

check-chat-history-browser.mjs.note: Actual ChatSurface with generated complete history, wheel scrolling, refresh growth and remount. Native log reads have Rust coverage.

check-media-reliability-browser.mjs.note: Actual chat components in Chromium with simulated media storage. Finder and native IPC acceptance are separate.

check-architecture-boundaries.mjs.reason: Repository shape (line ceilings, no provider SDK imports in UI modules) can only be read from files; there is no runtime behaviour to execute.

check-browser-capability.mjs.reason: The browser capability contract lives in Rust tables that Node cannot execute; this guard pins the table arms, the product-knowledge JSON and the loopback fixture together so Rust, docs and fixture cannot drift apart.

check-canvas-preview-browser.mjs.note: Drives a real Chromium browser against the Canvas preview; run through scripts/run-canvas-preview-browser.mjs, which boots the dev server when it is not already up.

check-chat-drag-browser.mjs.note: Drives production sidebar, pane-title, grid, composer and reducer through real browser events; run scripts/run-chat-drag-browser.mjs for an isolated fixture.

check-chat-drop-project.mjs.note: Executes the actual App drop callback and transactional grid dispatcher extracted through the TypeScript AST.

check-chat-side-panel.mjs.reason: The rail's defects were layout failures - the wrong track, the wrong specificity, a control group that cannot wrap; its assertions are written against source markup and CSS because that is the closest check to the painted result short of a full workbench run.

check-code-intelligence.mjs.note: UI-side parity executes the shipped label map and tool mapping; the Rust descriptor arms remain source-text because Node cannot execute the crate.

check-command-blocking.mjs.reason: Tauri's async/blocking contract is a property of the Rust sources; the guard statically proves disk work sits on spawn_blocking, which executing would require a live runtime latency probe.

check-guard-registry.mjs.reason: Meta-guard: runner reachability and verification-map coverage are properties of the repository's own text; there is nothing to execute.

check-language-server-registry.mjs.note: The UI half executes the merged languageDefinitions table; the Rust allowlist half stays extracted from source because the crate cannot run in Node.

check-release-recovery.mjs.note: Executes release source validation against disposable Git history; rejects unmerged, mismatched and malformed release requests.

check-release-config.mjs.reason: Release configuration is data - signing identity, updater endpoints, version surfaces, workflow stages; the packaged-artifact half of this contract runs in release CI (verify-macos-release.mjs).

check-ui-tokens.mjs.reason: Token coherence (definitions vs usage across styles.css, editor CSS and TS) is a cascade property; rendered-output assertions would need a browser and would still not pin specificity the way the text rules do.

check-editor-resource-lifecycle.mjs.note: Executes the production reducer, committed-ownership hook and event-driven model retirement, including dirty/shared files and rapid reopen.

check-editor-resource-browser.mjs.note: Drives production Monaco panes with synthetic files; asserts bounded buffers/models, split ownership, unsaved text, undo and cold rapid previews in an isolated browser profile.

check-workspace-navigation-browser.mjs.note: Drives the production Monaco pane, rename controller and dialog in a browser with explicitly mocked LSP/disk transport.

check-textmate-assets.mjs.note: Validates shipped grammar bytes, pinned provenance, license hashes and required include/injection closure.

check-textmate-runtime.mjs.note: Executes the shipped tokenizer with pinned grammars and WASM; validates multiline/embedded state, UTF-16 offsets and retry isolation.

check-workspace-syntax-browser.mjs.note: Drives production Monaco panes in StrictMode; checks rendered themes, local assets, offline edits and fault recovery.

check-cloud-chat-continuation.mjs.note: Exercises the native Cloud contract or production UI with isolated transports; no live payment or provider calls.

check-cloud-connection-view.mjs.note: Exercises the native Cloud contract or production UI with isolated transports; no live payment or provider calls.

check-cloud-connection-wire.mjs.note: Exercises the native Cloud contract or production UI with isolated transports; no live payment or provider calls.

check-cloud-services-state.mjs.note: Exercises the native Cloud contract or production UI with isolated transports; no live payment or provider calls.

check-cloud-settings-render.mjs.note: Exercises the native Cloud contract or production UI with isolated transports; no live payment or provider calls.

check-cloud-v2-contract.mjs.note: Exercises the native Cloud contract or production UI with isolated transports; no live payment or provider calls.

check-failure-notifications.mjs.note: Exercises failure notification routing and visibility with isolated event fixtures.

check-activity-composer-browser.mjs.note: Drives the production composer in an isolated Chromium profile, checking menu layout, keyboard focus and tooltips at three viewport widths.

check-browser-agent-runtime.mjs.note: Executes the shipped DOM agent in headless Chromium against disposable DOM fixtures without provider calls.

check-browser-draft.mjs.note: Executes production App draft-browser callbacks and chat reducers for stable ownership and migration.

check-browser-event-routing.mjs.note: Executes native browser queue, event callbacks and reducers for ordering and cross-chat ownership.

check-browser-interaction.mjs.note: Executes the production native-browser interaction owner callback.

check-browser-pane-visibility.mjs.note: Executes split ChatSurface visibility props and native bounds callbacks.

check-capability-lifecycle.mjs.note: Executes call reconciliation and run projection for terminal states, chronology and scoped identifiers.

check-chat-browser-shortcut.mjs.note: Executes the production chat browser keyboard handler and panel transitions.

check-chat-send-outcome.mjs.note: Executes structured send outcomes and retry ownership, including saved failures and cancellation.

check-companion-motion.mjs.note: Executes the production companion motion hook with deterministic layout and animation clocks.

check-native-shortcut-routing.mjs.note: Executes the production native shortcut dispatch callback with fixture events.

check-provider-quota.mjs.note: Executes quota classification, run projection and notice lifecycle across providers.

check-run-tasks.mjs.note: Bundles and executes production task grouping, presentation and persisted run records.

check-sidebar-project-groups.mjs.note: Bundles and executes production project grouping and draft keys.
